meta.name: skill-security-auditor
meta.description: Security audit and vulnerability scanner for AI agent skills before installation. Use when: (1) evaluating a skill from an untrusted source, (2) auditing a skill directory or git repo URL for malicious code, (3) pre-install security gate for Claude Code plugins, OpenClaw skills, or Codex skills, (4) scanning Python scripts for dangerous patterns like os.system, eval, subprocess, network exfiltration, (5) detecting prompt injection in SKILL.md files, (6) checking dependency supply chain risks, (7) verifying file system access stays within skill boundaries. Triggers: "audit this skill", "is this skill safe", "scan skill for security", "check skill before install", "skill security check", "skill vulnerability scan".

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以扫描 AI 技能（skill）的代码和配置文件，检查是否存在恶意代码、提示注入、依赖风险等问题，并给出通过、警告或失败的安全评级。
howto.when: 当你需要评估一个来自不可信来源的技能，或要求扫描技能目录、Git 仓库 URL 时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个技能目录是否安全。
say.note: Claude 会扫描指定目录并返回安全报告。

say.text: 检查这个 Git 仓库里的技能有没有恶意代码。
say.note: Claude 会克隆仓库并执行安全扫描。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can scan AI skill code and config files for malicious code, prompt injection, dependency risks, etc., and output a PASS/WARN/FAIL security verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to evaluate a skill from an untrusted source, or request scanning a skill directory or git repo URL.

say_en.text: Audit this skill directory for security.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the directory and return a security report.

say_en.text: Check this git repo skill for malicious code.
say_en.note: Claude will clone the repo and run a security scan.
